# forgejo_team_membership (Resource)

Forgejo team membership resource. Manages membership of users in teams.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    forgejo = {
      source = "svalabs/forgejo"
    }
  }
}

provider "forgejo" {
  host = "http://localhost:3000"
}

variable "test_password" { sensitive = true }

# Organization
resource "forgejo_organization" "owner" {
  name = "test_org"
}

# Team
resource "forgejo_team" "developers" {
  organization = forgejo_organization.owner.name
  name         = "developers"
  is_admin     = false

  permissions {
    code   = "write"
    issues = "write"
    pulls  = "write"
  }
}

# User
resource "forgejo_user" "alice" {
  login    = "alice"
  email    = "alice@example.com"
  password = var.test_password
}

# Add user to team
resource "forgejo_team_membership" "alice_dev" {
  team_id  = forgejo_team.developers.id
  username = forgejo_user.alice.login
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `team_id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the team.
- `username` (String) Username of the user to add to the team.
